CustomField.description: Rich text heading at the top of the page, above its sections, for a styled headline or intro richer than the plain Page Label. Also printed in the PDF. Separate from Page Label (the navigation and stage label) and Details (instructions).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A formatted heading or intro at the top of the page, above the sections, for text richer than the plain Page Label. Leave blank to show just the sections.
CustomField.label: Page Title
